title: Khudam lexicon entry
description: One Cyrillic word mapped to one or more traditional Mongolian script candidates. The cyrillic form is the unique key across the whole lexicon: lowercase, NFC-normalized, Cyrillic letters only.

cyrillic.description: Modern Mongolian Cyrillic form: lowercase а-я plus ё, ө, ү. Must be NFC-normalized.

candidates.description: All known traditional-script candidates for this Cyrillic form. Never collapse one-to-many mappings.

allOf.description: When a word has more than one candidate, every candidate must carry a sense label so users can tell them apart.

traditional.description: Traditional Mongolian script in standard Unicode: main block U+1800–U+18AF (includes FVS1–FVS3 U+180B–U+180D and MVS U+180E) plus NNBSP U+202F before written-apart suffixes. Logical code points only — never presentation forms.

latin.description: Optional romanization of the traditional form.

sense.description: Short meaning label distinguishing this candidate from others (e.g. "mountain" vs "original"). Required when the entry has multiple candidates.

verified.description: true only after a human reviewer confirmed the spelling via pull request. Machine imports are always false.
